questions.passage:
To all staff,

Please note that the office will be ___(1)___ on Friday afternoon so that the carpets can be cleaned. Employees are encouraged to work from home that afternoon. ___(2)___, please make sure your desks are clear of papers by noon. We ___(3)___ your cooperation.

Facilities Department
questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank (1).
questions.explanation: will be + 形容詞 / 過去分詞 → will be closed（將會關閉）。

optionNotes.closing: will be closing 是主動進行式，語意變成「辦公室正在關閉某物」
optionNotes.close: will be close 是「很接近」，語意不對
optionNotes.closure: 名詞，will be closure 不通
